title: Finding
description: One reported observation about one place in a diff. Every analyzer, in either lane and in any language, emits this shape (ADR-0003).

fingerprint.description: Stable across force-push and rebase; derived from the normalised snippet, not the line number. Filled in by the core — plugins may leave it empty.

ruleId.description: Namespaced by category, e.g. arch/no-domain-to-infra. Acceptance is measured per ruleId, so it must be stable across releases.

lane.description: Declared by the analyzer's plugin descriptor. The secrets gate blocks every llm-lane analyzer outright.

confidence.description: Drives presentation: only high goes inline, everything else into the collapsed summary.

severity.description: How bad the thing found is, independently of how sure the analyzer is.

file.description: Relative to the repository root, forward slashes.

endLine.description: 1-indexed and inclusive. Omitted when the finding is one line.

suggestion.description: Replacement text for the reported span; becomes a GitHub suggested change.

evidence.description: Why the analyzer believes this. Required in the llm lane.
